---

```{r}
#| label: setup
#| include: false

library(facspseudocolor)

config <- read_facs_config(params$config)
set.seed(1)
```

```{r}
#| label: optional-flowjo-export
#| message: true

if (isTRUE(params$run_flowjo_export)) {
  if (is.null(config$flowjo) &&
      !any(vapply(config$replicates, function(x) !is.null(x$flowjo), logical(1)))) {
    stop("`run_flowjo_export` was requested, but the config has no FlowJo settings.")
  }
  source("tools/flowjo-orchestration.R", local = TRUE)
  prepare_flowjo_csvs_external(config)
}
```

## Analysis

```{r}
#| label: analyze

analysis <- analyze_facs_experiment(config)
analysis
```

```{r}
#| label: quantitation

requested_quantitation <- c(
  if (isTRUE(config$quantify_phase_median)) "phase_median",
  if (isTRUE(config$quantify_whole_median)) "whole_median",
  if (isTRUE(config$quantify_phase_percent)) "phase_percent"
)

if (length(requested_quantitation)) {
  analysis <- quantify_cell_cycle(
    analysis,
    include = requested_quantitation,
    signal = config$quant_signal,
    reference_condition = config$quant_reference_condition
  )
  analysis$quantitation
}
```

```{r}
#| label: quantitation-plots

if (length(requested_quantitation)) {
  quantitation_plots <- plot_facs_quantitation(analysis, seed = 1)
  for (plot in quantitation_plots) print(plot)
}
```

## Pseudocolor panels

```{r}
#| label: pseudocolor-panels

plots <- plot_pseudocolor_panels(analysis)
plots
```

```{r}
#| label: save-results
#| include: false

if (isTRUE(params$save_outputs)) {
  save_facs_results(
    analysis,
    plots = plots,
    overwrite = isTRUE(params$overwrite)
  )
}
```
